subject.title: [Feature]: Include interaction metadata in Discord button callbacks

question: Should generic Discord component callbacks expose a new agent-visible structured interaction metadata envelope, and which fields are public versus plugin-only?
rationale: This changes the public agent inbound context and exposes Discord identifiers and callback data, so automation should not choose the schema or trust boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add typed agent metadata
options.body: Expose a narrow documented envelope with originating message id, action kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

options.title: Keep metadata plugin-only
options.body: Leave rich interaction fields only in plugin interactive handlers and document that stateful Discord workflows should use plugin callbacks rather than generic fallback messages.

options.title: Start with ids only
options.body: Expose only clicker and originating message ids first, deferring callback payload semantics until a broader inbound metadata contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Add typed agent metadata
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow documented envelope with originating message id, action kind, safe callback/custom data, label/value details, and clicker identity, backed by Discord plugin tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the Discord component fallback and plugin interactive paths is the closest history signal for deciding this public callback contract.
